cases.name: Olga Sanchez-Reyes
cases.narrative: He poured gasoline on the stairs leading up to her bedroom and set the home on fire while his three children were on the third floor. Their children were able to escape the home through a window, but 2 suffered injuries. She died from asphyxia, smoke inhalation and thermal burns. Investigators said she may have suffered other injuries prior to being killed but the burns on her body prevented them from being able to say for sure.
